items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Carl White--did you ever know him, a bass player? Yes, very well. [INTERVIEWEE] Carl was a youngster at that time...

ctx.x: Carl was a youngster at that time, but Warren was a football player and he was really on the ball. They went in this little joint to get a sandwich and they asked if they could get a sandwich and the man said yeah, and someone sitting around, I guess, you got no business in here, nigger, and so the proprietor said, the men want to get a sandwich to go--I think it was to go--they got no business coming in the front door. And so the man kept telling them they ain't going to be doing nothing.
And so the boys--they never did open their mouth--they got the sandwich and paid and came on out. When they came out, four or five cats came following them--
